case_source.adapter: Reuse metric collection semantics only; a new run must record exact prompts and request parameters in its workload bundle.

request_contract.concurrency_levels: result bundle must enumerate every tested level
request_contract.samples_per_case: result bundle must state a positive integer

definitions.ttft_seconds: request dispatch to first non-empty streaming delta
definitions.first_final_token_seconds: request dispatch to first final-answer token for reasoning models
definitions.decode_tokens_per_second: tokens after the first streamed token divided by the interval from first to last non-empty delta
definitions.output_tokens_per_second_e2e: completion tokens divided by response time
definitions.aggregate_tokens_per_second: concurrent batch completion tokens divided by batch wall time

evaluation: Client-observed timings and token counts are computed from the committed raw request records.
active_result_rule: Requires a new run against this exact suite identity; historical results remain Reference.
